# Selestial

> Selestial is an online jewellery store selling premium 925 sterling silver pieces — rings, chains, bracelets, earrings, pendants and sets. Free shipping on orders over $100.

Selestial ships worldwide from Australia. All pieces are solid 925 sterling silver (stamped), not plated. Prices are listed in USD on the storefront.

## Shop

- [All products](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/products): The full catalogue with filters for category, gender and price.
- [Rings](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/products?cat=rings): Signet, eternity, texture, chain and CZ rings.
- [Chains & necklaces](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/products?cat=necklaces): Curb, cuban and link chains, plus pendants.
- [Bracelets](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/products?cat=bracelets): Cuffs and link bracelets.
- [Earrings](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/products?cat=earrings): Studs, hoops, drops and cuffs.

## Buying

- [Cart](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/cart): Review items before checkout.
- [Checkout](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/checkout): Card payment via Stripe. Requires name, email, phone and shipping address.
- [Sign in or create an account](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/auth): Email and password, Google sign-in, or phone OTP.
- [Shipping & returns](https://selestial-lovat.vercel.app/shipping-returns): Delivery times, costs and the returns window.
